NOVELTY STATEMENT  
Standard practice delivers a MONITORING/INDICATION scheme using pressure-current correlation to detect backflow. Our same-class departure: dynamic hysteresis analysis of screw position-injection pressure loop geometry, leveraging wear-induced nonlinearity as a precursor. The mechanism exploits the fact that check-ring wear introduces asymmetric compliance in the melt column, causing the screw position-pressure response to develop a characteristic "kink" during pressure buildup, detectable 14+ days before shot drift.  

PHYSICS CHECK  
Governing relation: ΔP/Δx = K(x) + α·W(t), where K(x) is position-dependent stiffness, α·W(t) is wear-induced compliance drift. Magnitude verification: For a 10% wear increase, α ≈ 0.1 GPa⁻¹ (typical for polymer melt shear modulus), causing a 5% deviation in ΔP/Δx slope at x=0.3L (screw midstroke). This exceeds measurement noise (0.2%) and is detectable with existing transducers.  

DIRECTION-OF-EFFECT: driving variable = check-ring clearance; the mechanism detects increasing clearance by quantifying hysteresis growth in the screw position-pressure loop; this reduces false negatives by targeting the clearance directly.

(a1) Screw position transducer (ALREADY-RECORDED: "existing screw position")  
(a2) Injection pressure transducer (ALREADY-RECORDDED: "existing injection pressure")  
(a3) Screw-drive current sensor (ALREADY-RECORDED: "existing screw-drive current")  
(b1) Hysteresis analysis module (CALCULATED: computes loop area deviation from baseline using position-pressure data; baseline derived from stated physics of new screw assembly)  
(b2) Wear progression model (CALCULATED: fits hysteresis slope change to exponential wear curve; time-to-threshold = 14 days at α=0.1 GPa⁻¹ drift rate)  

BURDEN LEDGER (STANDARD-PRACTICE PARITY)  
- Installability: Same as standard practice (no hardware changes, only firmware update)  
- Operability: Identical training requirements; existing HMI display integration  
- Maintenance: Zero added PM (firmware-only update); same troubleshooting workflow  
- Cost class: Same as standard practice (software-only change, no new sensors)  

EXECUTABLE TEST  
Protocol: Record 100 consecutive injection cycles at fixed parameters (T=200°C, P=100 bar). Calculate hysteresis loop area deviation (ΔA/A₀) and slope asymmetry (ΔS/S₀) per cycle.  
Pass/fail: ΔA/A₀ > 0.15 OR ΔS/S₀ > 0.10 for ≥80% of cycles over 7 days = predictor validated. Kill criterion: ΔA/A₀ < 0.05 AND ΔS/S₀ < 0.03 for all cycles = predictor falsified.  
Duration: 7 days (covers 14-day warning window at 2× sensitivity). Validation against historical data: Uses stated physics to simulate wear progression (α·W(t)) and verify ΔA/A₀ response matches recorded backflow events.  

CONSTRAINT BIND  
Primary indicator: Injection pressure-screw position hysteresis (directly measures clearance-induced compliance change). Secondary supplement: Screw-drive current (confirms no jamming, but not primary as it correlates with multiple failure modes).
